title: tGAN-article
summary: A research codebase extending the 'gan-thesis' project to benchmark GAN-based tabular data synthesis methods across multiple datasets (adult, bank, telecom, news, and synthetic distributions), evaluating them with marginal, association, and ML-efficacy plots. It directly imports and runs the standalone ctgan package's CTGANSynthesizer as one of the generative models compared in these experiments.
